# WebDriverIO Template

This directory contains the WebDriverIO template. When `/setup-e2e-framework` selects WebDriverIO, it will scaffold this template into your application repository.

## Key Files (generated by /setup-e2e-framework)

- `wdio.conf.ts` — configuration with production guard in `onPrepare`
- `support/data-factory.ts` — registry pattern identical to the Playwright version
- `support/prod-guard.ts` — shared production URL validator
- `pageobjects/` — Page Object base class

## Production Guard (wdio.conf.ts)

```typescript
import { validateNotProduction } from './support/prod-guard';
import { loadQAConfig } from './support/qa-config-loader';

const qa = loadQAConfig();
const baseUrl = process.env.BASE_URL || qa.environments?.testEnvironmentBaseUrl;

export const config: WebdriverIO.Config = {
  baseUrl,
  onPrepare() {
    validateNotProduction(baseUrl, qa.productionProtection?.prodUrlPatterns || []);
  },
  onComplete() {
    DataFactory.cleanupAll();
  },
  // ...
};
```

## Data Factory

Same registry pattern as the Playwright template — see `templates/e2e/playwright/fixtures/data-factory.ts` for the pattern. Adapt `fetch` calls to use your application's API client.

Use `/setup-e2e-framework` to generate the full scaffold based on your application's tech stack.
